headline: U.S. Expands Semiconductor Export Bans to Chinese Overseas Entities, Escalating Tech War
summary: This significant regulatory shift directly impacts global geopolitics and supply chain logistics by further restricting China's access to advanced semiconductors for AI and critical infrastructure. The expansion of bans to overseas entities tightens the technological chokehold, forcing semiconductor fabs and AI developers worldwide to reassess their supply chains and strategic alignments amid a deepening US-China tech rivalry.
